footprint.method: Untimed warmed-process full-GC heap observations around one live prepared owner. Raw signed values retained; includes approximate managed backing graphs, excludes unchanged idle pools in baseline. No object census or allocation-to-retention equivalence. Production's explicit admitted capacity and governed peak are separate; no reference admission model. Physical/native/JIT stack peaks unmeasured.
